whyMatters.en: Montreal collective whose F♯ A♯ ∞ (1997) and Lift Your Skinny Fists (2000) set field-recording post-rock as long-form anarchic composition.
whyMatters.zh: 蒙特利尔集体；F♯ A♯ ∞（1997）与 Lift Your Skinny Fists（2000）把田野录音式 post-rock 做成大型无政府曲式。

shortBio.en: Montreal post-rock collective; East Hastings is the early drone landmark.
shortBio.zh: 蒙特利尔 post-rock 集体；East Hastings 是早期 drone 地标。

body.en:
Active from 1994 on Constellation Records. Early releases use spoken samples, tape hiss, and slow orchestral builds instead of verse-chorus.

East Hastings (1998) and Lift Your Skinny Fists (2000) are reference points for post-rock that rejects indie-song length. Membership is fluid; crescendo architecture plus found sound is the constant.
body.zh:
1994 年起于 Constellation 厂牌活动。早期作品用口语采样、磁带底噪与缓慢管弦渐强，而非主副歌。

East Hastings（1998）与 Lift Your Skinny Fists（2000）是拒绝 indie 歌曲长度的 post-rock 参照。成员流动；crescendo 结构加拾得声音是常量。

note.en: Field samples and slow drone—F♯ A♯ ∞ cinema-adjacent post-rock.
note.zh: 田野采样与慢 drone——F♯ A♯ ∞ 电影感 post-rock。

note.en: Lift Your Skinny Fists opening—orchestral swell and tape hiss as structure.
note.zh: Lift Your Skinny Fists 开场——管弦 swell 与磁带底噪作结构。

note.en: Spoken-word sample over drone—Constellation political post-rock document.
note.zh: 口语采样叠 drone——Constellation 政治 post-rock 文献。

body.en:
Godspeed matter for treating post-rock as political long-form—field recordings, spoken samples, 20+ minute side lengths.

F♯ A♯ ∞ (1997) and Lift Your Skinny Fists (2000) define the Constellation sound.

East Hastings uses urban field audio; Storm opens the double album with orchestral 延音.

No frontman—collective credit and rotating lineup.
body.zh:
Godspeed 要紧处是把 post-rock 当政治长曲式——田野录音、口语采样、20+ 分钟面长。

F♯ A♯ ∞（1997）与 Lift Your Skinny Fists（2000）定义 Constellation 声。

East Hastings 用城市田野音频；Storm 以管弦 延音 开双专。

无 frontman——集体署名与轮换编制。

body.en:
1994–2003 first run: Menuck, Moya, Amar, Girt, Trudeau, Pezzente plus expanded live ensemble.

Hiatus 2003–2010; reunion tours restore core with extra strings and glockenspiel.

Menuck also leads Silver Mt. Zion—shared personnel blurs band borders.

Live shows run dark rooms, film projections, no banter—production as ritual.
body.zh:
1994–2003 首轮：Menuck、Moya、Amar、Girt、Trudeau、Pezzente 加扩展现场编制。

2003–2010 hiatus；重组巡演恢复核心加额外弦乐与钟琴。

Menuck 亦领 Silver Mt. Zion——共享人事模糊乐队边界。

现场暗场、投影、无闲聊——制作即仪式。

body.en:
Godspeed influenced European and North American post-rock that treats samples and silence as compositional tools.

Sonic Youth’s noise and Radiohead’s ambient turns are distant cousins; Godspeed adds anarchist politics and Constellation infrastructure.

Mogwai and Explosions share crescendo grammar but Godspeed keeps longer forms and found sound.

Citation peak is 1997–2000 first run plus 2010s reunion albums.
body.zh:
Godspeed 影响把采样与沉默当作曲工具的欧美 post-rock。

Sonic Youth 噪声与 Radiohead ambient 转向是远亲；Godspeed 加无政府政治与 Constellation 基建。

Mogwai 与 Explosions 共享 crescendo 语法，Godspeed 保持更长形式与拾得声音。

引用峰值 1997–2000 首轮加 2010 年代重组专辑。
